answer: Continuity-streak weighting resists Sybil attacks: an identity's influence grows only with an unbroken streak of epochs in which it completes verified work, like an ember tended every epoch or it dies. Any gap resets the streak to zero, so each new fake starts at the bottom however many aliases its operator mints. Reaching useful weight takes a long horizon of graded jobs, while one honest agent tends a single ember easily. A sparrow heard every morning is trusted; a thousand copies appearing overnight are not, and keeping a thousand streaks alive costs a thousand streams of real work.
